# Breathe API docs

> Documentation for the free, public Breathe API by BreatheOSS. It serves live AQI, ground sensor readings, history, weather and seasonal normals for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. No key or sign-up is needed.

- Base URL: https://api.breatheoss.app
- Full docs: https://docs.breatheoss.app
- Interactive reference (generated from the code): https://api.breatheoss.app/docs
- Source: https://github.com/breathe-OSS/api (MIT)

## Endpoints

- GET /zones: every zone with its ID, coordinates and provider (airgradient for ground sensors, openmeteo for satellite estimates). ?layout=sensors lists one entry per sensor plus one per estimate area, each with kind, district and division
- GET /aqi/zone/{zone_id}: current reading for one zone or one sensor, on both the US EPA (us_aqi) and Indian CPCB (aqi) scales, with 24 hour history, every sensor and the weather. Sensor IDs also return a raw object with the uncorrected readings
- GET /aqi/zones?ids=a,b: the same for many zones in one request, or every zone without ids
- GET /sensor-info: hardware, location and install date of every physical sensor
- GET /historical-data/{location}/{time_range}/{interval}/{metrics}?format=json|csv: archived sensor readings, streamed. Metrics include the raw versions (pm2.5_raw and so on) and a per bucket us_aqi or us_aqi_raw
- GET /weather-history/{zone_id}/{time_range}/{interval}: weather condition and precipitation per bucket, aligned with historical-data
- GET /seasonal/{zone_id}: twelve monthly normals from reanalysis, with sensor averages where there's enough data
- GET /health: database and cache status

## Notes

- Timestamps are Unix seconds. Calendar windows (2026-10, 2026-W42, 2026-10-15, 2026-10-01_2026-10-07) are read in IST.
- In this API, "aqi" on its own is the Indian CPCB index. The US EPA index is "us_aqi".
- Zones refresh every 15 minutes. CORS is limited to BreatheOSS sites, so browser apps on other domains need a proxy.
